purpose: Model firmware-management protocols as additive, site-selectable adapters so H&H can preserve every credible control plane, rank the next observation path from local evidence, and switch protocol by hospital/device configuration without treating protocol selection as mutation authority.

experian_control_center.label: Experian / AxiaMed Control Center
experian_control_center.presentation_role: Primary healthcare-estate management candidate when estate evidence binds the reader to Control Center.

observation_dispatch.next_action: Open the authorized Experian/AxiaMed Control Center for the same reader and capture current version, package/domain labels, enrollment state, and update/history metadata without submitting an update.

provider_tms_ntms.label: Provider TMS / NTMS
provider_tms_ntms.presentation_role: Technical device/provider path; preferred over generic marketplace escalation when the hospital/device is already bound to a TMS.

observation_dispatch.next_action: On the same authorized reader, inspect the existing TMS/NTMS configuration and software/firmware information without changing endpoint, TID, policy, or requesting an update.

provider_managed_automatic.label: Provider-managed automatic update
provider_managed_automatic.presentation_role: Valid when the processor/acquirer owns update delivery and operators do not directly handle a firmware artifact.

observation_dispatch.next_action: Use the authorized provider/acquirer support surface to confirm current version, update policy, and update history for the same reader without requesting an update.

paxstore_reseller_push.label: PAXSTORE reseller / Administrator Center push
paxstore_reseller_push.presentation_role: Authoritative corroboration, support/email evidence, and production-capable fallback; not the default technical path when a more estate-specific control plane is evidenced.

observation_dispatch.next_action: Observe the same terminal in authorized PAXSTORE Administrator Center/OpenAPI and capture installed firmware/apps plus labeled package evidence without submitting Push Firmware/App.

pax_partner_paydroid_tool.label: PAX Partner Network / PayDroid Tool
pax_partner_paydroid_tool.presentation_role: Retained technical fallback for authorized lab/partner work; never auto-promoted to a production hospital reader.

observation_dispatch.next_action: On an explicitly controlled lab target with authorized partner tooling, inspect package/signature/build metadata only; do not use this route on a production hospital reader.

proof_ceiling: This contract and selector can prove protocol inventory, evidence-based ranking, site-specific preference behavior, and mutation-readiness gaps. They do not prove live entitlement, a package/version-domain bind, mutation authority, firmware deployment, rollback, or post-update runtime verification.

site_profile_contract.rule: Read-only protocol ranking may proceed without a proven site profile, but mutation readiness must remain BLOCKED_SITE_PROFILE until a proven H&H organization/site profile artifact is supplied. A site override may reorder or disable known protocols without erasing them.

dendritic_execution_model.rule: Observation, artifact acquisition/provider delivery, and deployment transport are independent branches. Evidence may come from different authorized sources; no branch is required to use the same provider or portal as another.
dendritic_execution_model.convergence_gate: Before mutation, bind one authoritative current-state observation, one package/version-domain or provider-delivery proof, one selected transport, a protocol-specific authority signal, and the required restore/live gates.
dendritic_execution_model.presentation_rule: Render explored, exhausted, fallback, and proven branches dendritically rather than as a single linear PAXSTORE funnel.

provider_acquirer_support.output: provider-supplied package, package identity, approved delivery request, or authoritative package/version mapping
provider_acquirer_support.rule: Use the hospital/acquirer/PSP/ISO support owner when it owns the deployed estate. Acquisition can succeed even when PAXSTORE is not used.

provider_tms_catalog.output: TMS package/version mapping or provider-delivered firmware pull
provider_tms_catalog.rule: TMS evidence may supply package identity and transport independently of marketplace evidence.

authorized_pax_partner_portal.output: signed PAX software/firmware artifact and metadata
authorized_pax_partner_portal.rule: Partner/dealer access is authorization-gated; a public-web miss is not evidence that the authorized portal lacks the artifact.

pax_support_channel.output: supported version path, package guidance, or channel-owner referral
pax_support_channel.rule: Use for vendor-supported package/version path and large-version-gap guidance.

paxstore_firmware_list.output: firmware inventory/package labels and optional remote-push candidate
paxstore_firmware_list.rule: Useful but not required for the technical critical path.

public_web_research.output: protocol-family evidence, manuals, version-domain clues, support routes
public_web_research.rule: Failure to find an exact package publicly never proves package absence. Capability-limited search routes to a successor research sprint rather than terminal exhaustion.

observation_refresh_policy.rule: Refresh authoritative current-state observation independently of package acquisition or mutation planning. A site/provider-specific scheduled cadence may be added only when its authenticated runtime and authority are proven.

version_evidence_capture_contract.purpose: Give the Kiosk4 field/operator lane a deterministic, classifier-native private capture shape for the bounded input check and labeled version observation without pre-filling current firmware or mutation authority.

fail_closed_conditions.meaning: A version string is present without both section and field_heading copied from the UI.
Section/field_heading use generic tokens that do not disambiguate the visible label.
Downstream classifier leaves VERSION_DOMAIN_UNRESOLVED; capture must not promote baseline.
Campaign target 2.0.15.260522 appears as an observed installed value without live current-state proof.
Device identity is missing, wrong model, or fleet reference does not bind to identity_binding_reference.
source_surface is absent or not on the Kiosk4 read-only allow list when observations exist.
observed_at is missing or blank when labeled observations are submitted.
Observation or capture marks provenance as inferred/derived instead of direct read-only UI capture.
Package/app metadata is paired with firmware-style headings without package-labeled context.
evidence_reference is set without source_surface and identity_binding_reference on the same capture.

ordered_success_transitions.gate: one bounded IME-selector check and one wired USB-HOST classification are dispositioned
same Kiosk4 identity has at least one exact labeled read-only version observation
Classify-HHCCReaderVersionDomain consumes labeled_observations without alias translation
authoritative current value is domain-bound to the same identity and the existing baseline evaluator freezes it

presentation_showcase_contract.owner: Google Drive: CC Reader Firmware Protocol Portfolio — Presentation Source
presentation_showcase_contract.role: ultimate showcasing layer over typed technical evidence
presentation_showcase_contract.source_authority: P95/P111 technical receipts, version-domain receipts, baseline receipts, and private evidence references

AWAITING_FIELD_OBSERVATION.presentation_meaning: The critical path is narrowed and prepared, but the installed value is not yet observed.

INPUT_PATH_CLASSIFIED.presentation_meaning: The local access branch is dispositioned; the next proof is the labeled installed-version observation.

LABELED_OBSERVATION_CAPTURED.presentation_meaning: An exact version value was captured, but its version domain is not yet promoted.

VERSION_DOMAIN_CLASSIFIED.presentation_meaning: The observed value has a proven version domain; baseline freeze is the next transition.

BASELINE_LOCKED.presentation_meaning: The same-reader current firmware baseline is locked; package/restore/authority gates become the next story.
